findings.note: FIXED. fetchUnpaid filtered .neq(status,paid) -> leaked CANCELLED commissions into the payable list/totals. Changed to .eq(status,pending). Codex finding-gate REAL + fix-gate SHIP. CommissionPayments.tsx:143.

DISAGREEMENT: Claude verifier=MEDIUM, Codex finding-gate=HIGH. transfer_job_to_invoice role-gates auth.uid() but never binds p_performed_by (no ACTOR_MISMATCH); stamps invoices.created_by=p_performed_by. Siblings save_job/complete_job DO reject mismatch. NOTE: feat/as-applied-invoices already has a PARKED strict-actor fix for this (commit 97836e8, G3) — coordinate so we don't double-fix. Migration.

Backfill invoice creator writes only activity_feed, no financial_audit_log 'invoice_created' row (siblings all do). Latent (0 prod invocations). Mirror create_invoice_from_order. IntegrityCleanup.tsx:316.
complete_delivery auto-creates a billable draft invoice but writes no financial_audit_log 'invoice_created' row. Same class as #1. Migration-only/additive.

Bulk prepay-apply (apply_remaining_prepayments + batch_apply_all_prepayments) decrements the customer cache but writes no prepay_applications / prepay_credits.balance_cents rows -> reconcile_prepay_balances can RE-CREATE the spent balance (double-spend). Route bulk paths through the apply_prepay_to_invoice FIFO+FOR UPDATE ledger. PrepaymentManager.tsx:390/:426. Verify live reachability before fixing.
void_payment partial-void leaves the invoice status stuck at 'paid' when balance is no longer zero. Derive status from balance_cents after the reversal.
transfer_job_to_invoice creates a money invoice but writes no financial_audit_log row. Fold into the same migration as the actor fix above.

load_recipe_into_job rewrites job_chemicals but leaves jobs.total_cost_cents/total_price_cents stale. Recompute at the tail. (Related code is also under active rework on feat/as-applied-invoices — coordinate.)
Field-billing split branch ROUNDs each invoice_share independently without reconciling to the invoice total (penny drift). Assign remainder to largest share. Low blast radius (0 split invoices live).

field_application invoices editable via generic InvoiceDetail -> save_invoice desyncs the field-app split tables. Fix is frontend-only (route field_application rows to /invoices/field-app/:id) BUT this exact segregation is being comprehensively reworked on feat/as-applied-invoices — PARK to avoid a merge collision rather than partial-fix on main.

create_quick_delivery validates inventory per-line independently, so duplicate product lines in one call can over-prebook. Aggregate by product_id before the net-available check. Defense-in-depth (UI already dedupes).
Re-bill guard only blocks payment_status='billed'; a ticket manually set to 'prepaid'/'no_charge' can still generate a second invoice. Widen guard to allow billing only from 'unbilled'.
